source.snippet: I wonder if is there a virtual PDF printer for Windows with the following additional features: Free use for non-personal/commercial applications. Not AGPL licensed (e.g. not based on Ghostscript). Not the 'Microsoft print to PDF' solution.

problem_statement: Businesses and developers need a commercial-use virtual PDF printer for Windows that is not encumbered by AGPL licensing (ruling out Ghostscript-based tools) and goes beyond the basic Microsoft solution.
target_segment: Windows software developers and IT teams at SMBs who need commercially licensable PDF generation tooling
notes: Clear commercial-use framing — the asker explicitly wants something legal for non-personal/commercial applications. Licensing friction is a known paid-software trigger. Existing commercial products (PDF995, Bullzip, etc.) have gaps here; a clean, affordable, MIT/commercial-licensed SDK or virtual printer could command a per-seat or per-call fee.
